articles.title: Toronto OPP investigating fatal cement truck crash on Hwy 401
articles.summary: The Toronto detachment of the Ontario Provincial Police is investigating a single-vehicle crash that resulted in the death of the driver on Highway 401 on Tuesday. Police responded to a collision involving a cement truck at around 9:20 a.m. on the on-ramp to Highway 401, eastbound from northbound Kennedy Road in Toronto. A cement truck […]

articles.title: GM, executive director of Ajax soccer club accused of defrauding club of $650K
articles.summary: The executive director and general manager of the Ajax FC Soccer Club have been accused of defrauding the club out of $650,000 over two years, Durham police allege. articles.title: Man dragged to death by NYC subway train after bag snags on door, police say
articles.summary: NEW YORK (AP) — A man was dragged to death by a New York City subway train when a bag he was carrying got stuck in the door during the Monday evening rush hour commute, according to police.

articles.title: 2 people charged with 1st-degree murder in 2025 Vaughan killing: YRP
articles.summary: Two people have been charged in connection with the death of 41-year-old Deuvane Donald Francis in Vaughan, Ont, last summer.

articles.title: Carney suggests immigration increase is on the horizon in New York Times interview
articles.summary: OTTAWA — Prime Minister Mark Carney says with Canada's immigration system back under control, the question now is when to begin a "controlled increase" of the country's population.

articles.title: 2 charged with 1st-degree murder in Vaughan homicide; guns, cocaine and ketamine seized
articles.summary: More than a year after a Toronto man was found dead inside a Vaughan commercial unit, York Regional Police (YRP) say two suspects have been charged with first-degree murder following a lengthy homicide investigation that also uncovered a cache of firearms, ammunition and illegal drugs. articles.title: Get ready, Scarborough: The new busway replacing Line 3 is almost open
articles.summary: The long-awaited Scarborough busway is set to open in just a few days. It will replace the route that the now-defunct Line 3 TTC line used to run. CBC’s Mercedes Gaztambide gives you an inside look at the new bus.

articles.title: Crews clean up 2nd spill at Scarborough creek linked to subway extension work
articles.summary: Crews from the city and the province have cleaned up a second spill in Scarborough's West Highland Creek linked to work on a subway extension in the area.
